text_block_list.text:
After Tap Dance City's victory in the Japan Cup,
the streets were abuzz with talk about Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, who do you think is
the greatest front-runner Umamusume in history?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be Silence Suzuka, right?
Or maybe Ines Fujin?

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, isn't that the Umamusume
who led wire-to-wire in this year's Kinko Sho, Takarazuka Kinen, and Japan Cup...?

Hahahaha. That's correct!
When it comes to the ultimate front-runner, that's me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's Katsuragi Ace!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's true that Tap's recent growth has been insane.
Even so, I'm not handing over the title of the strongest anytime soon!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, Ace. That's out of line. Your role now is just to watch over them. Besides..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"My front-running was taught to me directly by you.
Whichever of us is the strongest, it amounts to pretty much the same thing, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Handed down directly...
I suppose it's something like that...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

It was just a trivial conversation. Yet, mid-sentence,
Katsuragi Ace suddenly fell silent.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
What's your take on this?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's about "Tap's front-running."
I'd say that Japan Cup was its perfected form, but...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think Tap's running style resembles?
Me, obviously, right?

—I think. It's true that there are various types of
front-running Umamusume, each with their own running style, but...

Take Silence Suzuka, for instance. A 'High-Speed Stability' type
who tears through from start to finish at blinding speed.

Take Twin Turbo, for instance. Running wild and completely crashing is a given.
After that, it's all up to luck—the 'Whatever Happens, Happens' type.

And Katsuragi Ace. She flies out early, catches her
breath, then re-accelerates—a "two-stage dash" type...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: How's that? Does it resemble someone?
choice_data_list: ...I feel like they're not like anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: From anyone? Even Ace?
choice_data_list: Yeah, slightly. Tap's front-running style is...

text_block_list.text:
With a massive stride, she accelerates with ease.
Not out of control, but the type to burst ahead early on.
And then—

Though she uses a "two-stage sprint,"
she crosses the finish line in a fluid glide.
Unlike Katsuragi Ace, she runs utilizing momentum.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. While incorporating my own style,
it feels like it's become a run unlike anyone else's."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Rather than constantly accelerating, once she's up to speed, she entrusts herself to the tailwind. That running style is almost like...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—It's a sailing ship.
Though it looks entirely original to Tap.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"A yacht..."
A yacht, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. When I'm running in the lead,
what I feel is certainly—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"The sea breeze!!
――It's the ocean wind."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Leaping to the front! Riding the wind! Surrounded by the ocean!
Pulling everyone along, charging forward endlessly!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: In that moment, I was—free!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, running from the front is
my whole way of life. And so—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's your ideal too, isn't it?
choice_data_list: You're right. No doubt about it.

text_block_list.text:
If you burst in with enough initial speed,
you can set a great flow.
So let's stretch out early, then lock it down later.

"That was the front-running style
that Tap Dance City and I finally arrived at."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay. Carrying on the Ace's spirit,
with this yacht dyed in our own colors—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Let's sail on!!
Let's lead the era.
I'm always the one out in front!"
